annotation.title_clean: 交通运输部等十部门关于印发《促进小微型客车租赁高质量发展三年行动方案（2026—2028年）》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice by the Ministry of Transport and nine other departments on issuing the Three-Year Action Plan (2026–2028) for promoting high-quality development of small and micro passenger car rental
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 交通运输部 et al. (Ministry of Transport of China and nine other departments)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese ten-department notice issuing a 2026–2028 action plan to develop small passenger car rental: expanding networks at airports and rail stations, free cross-region returns, market order and credit systems, finance and insurance support, and regulatory revisions. Not about AI or robotics beyond passing mention of AI/IoT for fleet dispatch.
key_provisions_or_claims: Rental outlets at qualifying airports and high-speed rail stations by 2028
Free cross-region vehicle returns in key city clusters by end-2028
Mutual recognition of rental vehicle registration across regions
Model rental contracts, credit evaluation system for rental firms
Revise Road Transport Regulations and rental management measures
